subject: Update on PO-2026-0440 and PO-2026-0441
body_text:
Hello Alice,

Quick update on your two orders:
- PO-2026-0440 (600 m cotton fabric): confirmed, ships Dec 3 as planned.
- PO-2026-0441 (400 m linen fabric): the dye lot failed QC, so the ship date moves from Dec 3 to Dec 17.

Best,
Sam Park
